title: Pharmacy Services Note: Medication Packaging for Respite and Short-Term Stays
content:
Pharmacy services packs a guest's medication for a stay under the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement according to the length of the stay, and the packaging charge follows the packing method.

**Packing methods.** The packaging charge is worked out by one of three methods: for a stay of twenty-one or more planned nights (21 or more) the medication is packed in fourteen-night cycles (14 nights) and each started cycle is charged sixty dollars (60.00); for a stay of seven or fewer planned nights (7 or fewer) a single short pack is charged fifty-five dollars (55.00); for any other stay — 8 to 20 planned nights — the medication setup fee of the stay type is charged once.

**Planned nights.** The planned nights are the planned departure date less the planned arrival date, both as recorded on the stay.

**Started cycles.** A cycle is started as soon as any night of it is planned: 21 to 28 planned nights take 2 cycles, 29 to 42 take 3 cycles, and so on.

## Packaging charge by planned nights

| Planned nights | Method | Packaging charge |
|---|---|---|
| 5 | Single short pack | 55.00 |
| 7 | Single short pack | 55.00 |
| 8 | Medication setup fee of the stay type, once | That fee |
| 20 | Medication setup fee of the stay type, once | That fee |
| 21 | 14-night cycles, 2 started | 2 times 60.00, that is 120.00 |
| 28 | 14-night cycles, 2 started | 120.00 |
| 29 | 14-night cycles, 3 started | 180.00 |
| 45 | 14-night cycles, 4 started | 240.00 |

## Hypothetical illustration

A hypothetical Post-Hospital Recovery Stay planned from 3 March to 1 April has 29 planned nights; its medication is packed in 3 started cycles, a packaging charge of 180.00.
